summary: This is the console output of the Library program: three book titles stored in a List<String> and printed one per line by a for loop.

lines.text: The first title appears on its own line because it was the first element added to the list, and a list preserves the order in which items are inserted.
The second pass of the loop reaches the second element, showing that the loop walks the list one item at a time rather than printing everything at once.
The last title is printed and the loop stops, because the loop is driven by the size of the list and there is no fourth element to visit.
